items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯工程主管安德鲁·肖夫林盛赞安东内利夺冠表现，同时为电池故障毁掉拉塞尔的周日公开道歉。

items.originalTitle: Mercedes boss praises Antonelli’s masterclass while admitting they failed George Russell
items.summaryEn: Mercedes engineering director Andrew Shovlin praised Antonelli's title-winning performance while publicly apologising for the battery failure that ruined Russell's Sunday.
detailZh: 梅赛德斯领队盛赞安东内利的大师级表现，同时承认他们辜负了乔治·拉塞尔
安德鲁·肖夫林盛赞安东内利的夺冠之路，同时为毁掉拉塞尔周日的电池故障道歉
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯
致梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭车队的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道的布拉克利车库，见证了赛车运动的绝对极端。周日，车队成功加冕了F1历史上最年轻的世界车手冠军，但与此同时，工程部门高层却被迫因机械故障向车库另一侧公开道歉。
墨西哥城大奖赛后，赛道工程总监安德鲁·肖夫林迅速赞扬了这位新晋冠军，并强调了极为有效的轮胎策略。这位20岁的意大利车手执行了超长的首段赛程，将软胎坚持到40圈以上，从而对场上其他车手形成了显著的战略错位。
“恭喜基米赢得他的首个世界冠军，”肖夫林赛后表示。“这是一场相当多事的比赛，但他在第一段对软胎的管理做得非常出色，能够坚持超过40圈。”
尽管第45圈的红旗抹去了这来之不易的轮胎优势，这位年轻天才在重启后并未退缩。他从第四位全力推进，干净利落地超越了法拉利的查尔斯·勒克莱尔，抢下季军，排在分站冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘和刘易斯·汉密尔顿之后，锁定了2026年的总冠军。
这位工程主管解释道：“他重新起步时排在第4位，但对勒克莱尔完成了一次非常漂亮的超越，重新回到领奖台位置，此后他跑了一场控制得非常好的比赛，拿下第3名和总冠军。整个赛季他的驾驶都非常出色，今天在一切悬而未决的情况下处理比赛的方式，再次证明了他取得的进步。”
当冠军庆祝活动在围场一侧拉开帷幕时，肖夫林对毁掉乔治·拉塞尔下午的机械失误给出了直率的评价。
这位英国车手从发车格第2位起步，却在到达第一个刹车区之前就遭遇了电池输出故障。电能的突然缺失让他在巨大的主直道上不断丢位置，彻底毁掉了他的比赛策略，最终导致他在6号弯撞转红牛的伊萨克·哈贾尔，被处以一次绝望而笨拙的10秒罚时。
肖夫林承认：“乔治这个下午很艰难，但这并非他自己的过错。在通往1号弯的路段上出现的输出问题让他丢了好几个位置，从一开始就让他陷入被动。从那以后，他不得不在车流中追赶，而与哈贾尔的接触以及随后的罚时让这项任务更加艰难。”
尽管早早打转、被罚时，又遭遇严重车流，这位老将依然保持冷静，奋力拼下一个来之不易的第六名完赛。不过，梅赛德斯维修区墙（pitwall）拒绝为电气故障找借口。
“这很令人沮丧，因为我们没给他所需要的比赛起步，这是我们车队的责任，”赛道总监坦言。
车手总冠军已稳稳收入囊中，但这家德国制造商毫无松油门的打算，围场即将收拾行装前往英特拉格斯。
“前往巴西之前，我们还有很多要专注的事情，”肖夫林总结道。“我们希望把车队总冠军也加到车手总冠军之上，我们知道仍必须拿出相应的表现才能做到。今天我们会好好享受，然后很快把注意力转向下一场比赛。”
detailEn: Mercedes boss praises Antonelli’s masterclass while admitting they failed George Russell
Andrew Shovlin praises Antonelli's title run while apologising for the battery failure that ruined Russell's Sunday
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

The Brackley garage experienced the absolute extremes of motorsport at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodríguez. While the team successfully crowned the youngest world drivers' champion in Formula 1 history on Sunday, the engineering brass was simultaneously forced to publicly apologise to the other side of the garage for a mechanical failure.

Trackside Engineering Director Andrew Shovlin was quick to praise his newly minted champion following the Mexico City Grand Prix, highlighting a brutally effective tyre strategy. The 20-year-old Italian executed a massive opening stint, nursing the soft compound rubber well past the 40-lap mark to create a significant strategic offset against the rest of the grid.

"Congratulations to Kimi on his first world championship," Shovlin remarked after the race. "It was quite an eventful race, but he did a really good job managing the Soft tyre in the first stint and was able to run it beyond 40 laps."

While the Lap 45 red flag wiped out that hard-earned tyre advantage, the young prodigy did not flinch on the restart. Dropping the hammer from fourth place, he executed a clinical pass on Ferrari's Charles Leclerc to snatch a podium finish behind race winner Max Verstappen and Lewis Hamilton, sealing the 2026 crown.

"He restarted P4 but made a very good move on Leclerc to get back into the podium positions and drove a very controlled race from there to take P3 and the title," the engineering boss explained. "He has driven superbly across the season and the way he handled the race today, with everything that was at stake, was another demonstration of the progress he has made."
While the championship celebrations kicked off on one side of the paddock, Shovlin offered a blunt assessment of the mechanical blunder that ruined George Russell's afternoon.

Launching from second on the grid, the British driver suffered a battery deployment failure before ever reaching the first braking zone. The sudden lack of electrical energy caused him to bleed positions on the massive main straight, completely destroying his race strategy and ultimately leading to a desperate, clumsy 10-second penalty for spinning Red Bull's Isack Hadjar at Turn 6.

"George had a difficult afternoon through no fault of his own," Shovlin admitted. "The deployment issue on the run to Turn 1 cost him several positions and put him on the back foot from the very start. From there, he was having to recover in traffic, and the contact with Hadjar and subsequent penalty made that task harder."

Despite the early spin, the time penalty, and the heavy traffic, the veteran charger kept his composure to salvage a hard-fought sixth-place finish. Still, the Mercedes pitwall refused to make excuses for the electrical glitch.
"It’s frustrating because we didn’t give him the start to the race that he needed, and that is on us as a team," the trackside director confessed.
With the drivers' crown firmly secured, the German manufacturer has zero intention of lifting off the throttle as the paddock packs up for Interlagos.

"We have plenty to focus on as we head to Brazil," Shovlin concluded. "We want to add the Constructors’ Championship to the Drivers’ title, and we know we still must deliver the performances to do that. We’ll enjoy today, then turn our attention very quickly to the next race."

items.titleZh: 赫塔获得另一次凯迪拉克F1练习机会以获得超级执照
items.summaryZh: 凯迪拉克将给科尔顿·赫塔在巴西大奖赛上提供另一次练习机会，以帮助他获得最后一点积分，从而最终获得F1超级执照。尽管赫塔在墨西哥FP1的亮相原本被认为足以让他达到目标，但由于IndyCar网站上的错误，这一目标未能实现。
items.originalTitle: Herta gets another Cadillac F1 practice to earn superlicence
detailZh: 凯迪拉克将给科尔顿·赫塔在巴西大奖赛上提供另一次练习机会，以帮助他获得最后一点积分，从而最终获得F1超级执照。
这将是在本赛季中，赫塔与凯迪拉克的第六次FP1练习，他将取代塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯。车队原本只需要进行四次练习来满足新手的练习要求，但赫塔仍然缺少所需的40个超级执照积分。
尽管车队最初认为赫塔在墨西哥FP1的亮相将使他达到目标，但后来发现这是错误的，因为IndyCar网站上出现了错误。
这个错误让赫塔在IndyCar排名中从第七位变成了第六位，导致多算了两个额外的超级执照积分。
凯迪拉克今年早些时候确实确认了与FIA的错误计算，但在墨西哥大奖赛周末，赫塔需要再进行一节练习才能获得40分。
赫塔在2023年IndyCar中取得第10名获得1分，2024年取得亚军获得30分，2025年取得第7名获得4分，加上四个FP1赛段的积分（赫塔在蒙扎的里程不足，无法获得超级驾照积分），目前他共有39分。
凯迪拉克原本计划在年底前让赫塔再进行一节FP1练习，因为他是有望在下赛季接替瓦尔特里·博塔斯的车队主要竞争者之一。
但如果没有超级驾照，他就无法获得那个座位，所以凯迪拉克在第一个机会下为他完成最后所需的积分是一个合理的举动。
他在巴西获得积分也没有保证——因为他还需要在FP1中至少完成24圈才能达到必要的100公里以获得积分。
凯迪拉克在墨西哥遭遇了严重的可靠性问题，当时瓦尔特里·博塔斯的左前悬挂突然失效。
车队正在调查问题的原因，因为今年早些时候佩雷斯的车上也出现过类似的问题。
detailEn: Cadillac will give Colton Herta another practice outing at the Brazilian Grand Prix to earn him the last point he needs to finally secure his Formula 1 superlicence.

This will be Herta's sixth FP1 outing of the season with Cadillac and he'll replace Sergio Perez. The team only needed to do four to satisfy the rookie practice requirements - but Herta's still short of the 40 superlicence points needed.
That's despite the team initially believing Herta's Mexico FP1 appearance would get him there, which turned out to be wrong because of an error on IndyCar's website.
That error had Herta sixth in the IndyCar standings instead of seventh, creating a miscalculation of two extra superlicence points.
Cadillac did verify that erroneous calculation with the FIA earlier this year but it emerged over the Mexico GP weekend that Herta would need another session to get to 40 points.

Herta picks up one point for finishing 10th in IndyCar in 2023, 30 points for finishing runner-up in 2024, and four points for being seventh in 2025, which, with points for four FP1s (Herta didn't complete enough mileage at Monza to get the superlicence point), leaves him with 39 points currently.
Cadillac was already planning to run Herta in another FP1 session before the end of the year as he's one of the leading contenders to replace Valtteri Bottas in the team next season.
But he can't get that seat if he doesn't have a superlicence, so Cadillac ticking off the last point he needs at the first available opportunity is a logical move.
There's no guarantee he'll get the point in Brazil either - as he'll still need to complete at least 24 laps in FP1 to reach the necessary 100km to earn the point.
Cadillac suffered a major reliability issue in Mexico when Valtteri Bottas's front-left suspension failed dramatically.
The team is investigating the cause of the issue, having experienced similar problems on Perez's car earlier this year.

detailZh: 埃斯蒂班·奥康将不会再次为哈斯车队参赛，拉斐尔·卡马拉将取代他在圣保罗大奖赛中的位置。
埃斯蒂班·奥康将不再为哈斯车队参赛；F2锦标赛领跑者拉斐尔·卡马拉将现在与奥利·贝尔曼在圣保罗大奖赛中搭档。
埃斯蒂班·奥康在墨西哥城的第二次练习赛中通过车队无线电质疑哈斯更改他的比赛计划的决定。
哈斯车队已确认，埃斯蒂班·奥康本赛季将不再为车队参赛，F2锦标赛领跑者拉斐尔·卡马拉将在本周末的圣保罗大奖赛中首次亮相F1。
卡马拉，已经被宣布将从2027年开始取代奥康的位置，将比预期更早成为F1车手。
据了解，奥康在上周末的墨西哥站比赛中与车队发生了争执。

items.titleZh: 哈斯车队提前解约奥康，卡马拉出战巴西站
items.summaryZh: 哈斯车队宣布埃斯特班·奥康本赛季剩余比赛不再回归车手席位，拉法·卡马拉将顶替其出战巴西大奖赛。此前奥康在墨西哥站练习赛后与车队领队小松礼雄发生冲突，中途被撤下。
items.originalTitle: Haas drops Ocon for rest of 2026 F1 season
items.summaryEn: Haas has announced that Esteban Ocon will not return to a race seat for the remainder of the Formula 1 season, with Rafa Camara replacing him at the Brazilian Grand Prix. Ocon was pulled from the car mid-way through last weekend's Mexico event after a reported confrontation with team boss Ayao Komatsu following Friday practice.
detailZh: 埃斯特班·奥康已被哈斯车队永久撤下车手席位，将缺席本赛季剩余的一级方程式比赛，本周末的巴西大奖赛将由拉法·卡马拉顶替出战。
奥康在上周末墨西哥站比赛进行到中途时意外被撤下，据报道原因是周五练习赛后与车队领队小松礼雄发生了冲突。
这是双方日益紧张关系的一次突然升级，而这段关系本来今年就会结束——哈斯此前已决定在2027年用F2争冠车手、法拉利青训车手卡马拉替换奥康。
如今这一更换提前发生，不过哈斯宣布与奥康彻底分手的声明目前只确认卡马拉出战巴西站。墨西哥站最初顶替奥康出场的是平川亮。
小松表示：“我们现在已经通知埃斯特班·奥康，他本赛季将不会再以TGR哈斯F1车队正式车手的身份参赛。”
“这样的决定从来都不是轻易做出的，墨西哥城的情况也是如此——但当时和现在一样，我们坚信这最符合车队未来发展的利益。”
“车队与埃斯特班最终展开的对话仍属内部事务，我们将继续尊重闭门会谈的私密性质。”
在墨西哥站第二节自由练习期间，奥康在无线电中表达了一些不满，这种情绪在练习结束后仍未消散。
单独来看，这似乎不是什么大问题——奥康多次抱怨，因为车队已经在奥利·贝尔曼的轮胎上观察到了情况，所以让他用中性胎而不是软胎进行更长距离的高燃油载油测试。
但这一事件发生在奥康即将离队以及背后内部冲突的背景下，奥康对哈斯今年遇到的问题越来越感到沮丧，并且坚信自己下赛季被替换并非出于合理的性能原因。
周五晚上，他们没有放下那些平淡无奇的无线电抱怨，而是试图进一步讨论此事，结果导致了对抗。
奥康否认这导致了肢体暴力，而包括法国《队报》在内的一些报道暗示了这一点。哈斯方面无人愿意评论具体发生了什么，但事态严重到足以促使车队立即采取严厉措施，奥康被立即除名。
这件事在周五晚上结束，平川在周六一大早得知了情况。作为哈斯车队主要计划的一部分，他在周五的第一次自由练习中驾驶过赛车，他告诉日本媒体，他在早上6点30分接到电话，通知他将完成这个周末的比赛。
哈斯专注于完成墨西哥周末剩余的比赛，并帮助平川在非常困难的情况下应对意外的F1首秀，最终获得了意想不到的积分。
重启后，平川在后期超越了两位威廉姆斯车手，这原本只是为了在赛道上争夺第13名，但在前方三位车手受到处罚后，最终变成了哈斯与奥迪在车队积分榜争夺中可能至关重要的第10名。
周末过后，哈斯与奥康之间的对话转向了今年剩余时间会发生什么。
尽管奥康肯定想为发生的事情做出弥补，但事态严重到哈斯车队显然认为已经不可逆转地越过了底线——因此坚持将奥康永久撤出这个席位。
detailEn: Esteban Ocon has been permanently dropped by Haas for the remainder of the Formula 1 season and will be replaced by Rafa Camara for this weekend’s Brazilian Grand Prix.
Ocon was unexpectedly benched in the middle of last weekend’s Mexico event after a reported confrontation with team boss Ayao Komatsu on Friday after practice.
It was a sudden escalation in an increasingly tense relationship that was going to end this year anyway after Haas opted to replace Ocon with F2 title contender and Ferrari junior Camara in 2027.
That will now happen early, although Haas’s statement announcing the total split with Ocon only confirmed Camara for Brazil for now. Ryo Hirakawa had stepped in for Ocon initially in Mexico.
“We have now notified Esteban Ocon that he will not return to a race seat with TGR Haas F1 Team this season,” said Komatsu.
“Such decisions are never taken lightly, as was the case in Mexico City - but then, as now, we feel this is firmly in the best interests of the team moving forward.
“The conversations that ultimately unfolded between the team and Esteban remain an internal matter, and we will continue to respect the private nature of closed-door situations.”
There had been some frustration from Ocon over the radio during Mexico FP2, which lingered after the session.

It did not appear a major issue in isolation - Ocon complained repeatedly about being told he would do his longer high-fuel run on mediums, rather than softs, because of what the team had already observed on Ollie Bearman’s tyres.

But it came against the backdrop of Ocon’s impending exit and the internal clashes behind that, with Ocon feeling increasingly frustrated with Haas’s problems this year and a steadfast belief he has not been replaced for next season because of legitimate performance reasons.
Instead of moving on from unremarkable radio grumbling, an attempt to further discuss the matter on Friday evening led to a confrontation.

Ocon denies it resulted in physical violence, which some reports including one in French newspaper L’Equipe implied. Nobody at Haas will comment on exactly what occurred but it was serious enough to prompt immediate, draconian action as Ocon was dropped immediately.

The matter ended Friday evening, and Hirakawa was informed of the situation very early Saturday morning. Having driven in Friday’s FP1 as part of his main Haas programme, he told Japanese media it was 6.30am he received the call he would complete the weekend.
Haas focused on completing the rest of the Mexico weekend and helping Hirakawa handle a surprise F1 debut in very difficult circumstances, which was rewarded with an unexpected point.

Hirakawa passed the two Williams drivers late on after the restart, which was originally only for 13th on the road but ended up being for a potentially crucial 10th place in Haas’s constructors’ championship fight with Audi after penalties for three drivers ahead.
After the weekend, the dialogue between Haas and Ocon turned to what happens for the rest of the year.

Though Ocon would have surely wanted to try to make amends for whatever happened, it was serious enough that Haas clearly felt a line had been irreversibly crossed – so pressed on with removing Ocon from the seat permanently.

Haas's statement only confirmed Camara for Brazil for now; Ryo Hirakawa had initially stepped in for Ocon in Mexico.
